description.value: Walnut Beach Resort is a full-service lakefront suite resort on Osoyoos Lake, set against Canada's only desert landscape with vineyard and mountain vistas. Suites feature fully equipped kitchens and kitchenettes, and the property includes a private beach, heated outdoor pool, hot tubs, and on-site dining at Pointe 49 Kitchen & Bar. It is a prominent destination resort in one of BC's sunniest regions, close to wine tours, cycling routes, and the US border.

address.value: 4200 Lakeshore Drive, Osoyoos, British Columbia, Canada V0H 1V6

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and provides detailed amenity information for Walnut Beach Resort. The amenities page explicitly lists 'Complimentary WiFi', 'Guest Laundry Facilities', 'EV Charging Station', and 'Pointe 49 Kitchen & Bar' (on-site dining). No mention of bike-specific storage, bike rooms, tools, pump, or hose is found anywhere in the website content, so those remain null. OSM wheelchair=no conflicts with the FAQ which states accessible rooms are available.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating lakefront resort in Osoyoos with a full website, bookable suites, and on-site amenities useful to touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: The on-site 'Walnut Beach Marketplace' is listed as an amenity but its inventory is not described — it may function as a small convenience shop rather than a full grocery, so nearby grocery was left null.
